The performer will design, implement, and evaluate a prototype capability, validating performance against beam quality-related benchmarks under realistic operational conditions. Expected outcomes include a measurable improvement in beam quality factor and a documented transition path informed by operational stakeholder feedback.

grants.title: Toward robust high-energy laser beam control: Implications for directed-energy weapon test-bed evaluation
grants.abstract: This effort develops high-energy laser beam control to address persistent beam quality-driven challenges in directed-energy weapon test-bed evaluation. The team will conduct a phased study combining high-power microwave source design with legacy system integration to reduce risk prior to a transition decision. Expected outcomes include a measurable improvement in engagement range and a documented transition path informed by operational stakeholder feedback. A principal risk to schedule is beam quality; the performer will mitigate this through early prototyping and government checkpoint reviews.

grants.title: Toward scalable self-supervised representation learning: Implications for predictive maintenance for shipboard systems
grants.abstract: This effort develops self-supervised representation learning to address persistent trust calibration-driven challenges in predictive maintenance for shipboard systems. Research activities include algorithm development, federated learning integration, and iterative field evaluation to quantify gains in operator trust score. Expected outcomes include a measurable improvement in operator trust score and a documented transition path informed by operational stakeholder feedback. Key technical risks include model drift and constrained latency, which will be tracked via quarterly milestone reviews.

grants.title: Low-Latency Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Sensor Fusion for Contested Environments
grants.abstract: This effort develops multi-agent reinforcement learning to address persistent edge deployment-driven challenges in sensor fusion for contested environments. Research activities include algorithm development, federated learning integration, and iterative field evaluation to quantify gains in false-alarm rate. Expected outcomes include a measurable improvement in false-alarm rate and a documented transition path informed by operational stakeholder feedback.

grants.title: Advancing synthetic biology pathway engineering to Improve biofilm-resistant hull coatings
grants.abstract: This effort develops synthetic biology pathway engineering to address persistent assay sensitivity-driven challenges in biofilm-resistant hull coatings. The performer will design, implement, and evaluate a prototype capability, validating performance against biomarker specificity-related benchmarks under realistic operational conditions. Expected outcomes include a measurable improvement in assay sensitivity and a documented transition path informed by operational stakeholder feedback.
